content: उत्थापनम् .²1 Causing to rise, come up, or get up. .²2 Raising, elevating. .²3 Causing to leave (a house). .²4 Exciting, instigating. .²5 Awakening, rousing (<ab>fig.</ab> also). .²6 Vomiting. .²7 Finishing, completing. .²8 Bringing about. .²9 Bringing forth. .²10 (In <ab>Math.</ab>) Finding the quantity sought, an answer to the question, substitution of a value (<ls>Colebr.</ls>). .{@-नी@} The concluding verse (ऋच्).
